Interested in Joining Us?

I am always keen to hear from individuals interested in opportunities within the lab. I am particularly interested in hearing from those applying for postdoctoral fellowships, such as Wellcome or UKRI. I am also open to supervising prospective PhD and MPhil students. Current vacancies are listed on the University of Cambridge jobs page. Potential collaborators are welcome to get in touch by email.

Current Opportunities

PhD Studentship on AI in Health Emergency Preparedness

Supervisor-led CamDTP PhD Studentship “Help or Harm? AI in Health Emergency Preparedness”

Information for Applicants

Background and Rationale Health emergency preparedness systems are increasingly exploring the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to support functions such as surveillance, forecasting, communication, planning and decision support. Governments and public health agencies are investing considerable effort in understanding how these technologies might strengthen preparedness capabilities and improve responses to future emergencies. Health emergency preparedness encompasses activities such as surveillance, risk assessment, preparedness planning, exercising, communication and coordination. These activities are delivered through systems that bring together public health agencies, healthcare organisations, government bodies, laboratories and data infrastructures. While considerable attention has focused on the capabilities of AI tools, much less is known about their effects on preparedness systems as a whole. Preparedness systems can be understood as complex adaptive systems, where interventions may generate both intended and unintended consequences. AI-enabled interventions may strengthen resilience and improve preparedness capabilities, but they may also introduce new vulnerabilities, dependencies or unintended effects. This project examines how AI-enabled interventions interact with health emergency preparedness systems and the conditions under which they improve resilience or create new challenges.
